messages:
jamie-runtime: Quick sanity check — can someone run a short smoke compare across H100 / A100 / L40S for rw-instruct-30b @ 2048 tokens? Seeing a p95 bump in prod traces (~820ms on H100) and want to rule out HW skew before digging deeper.

alex-gpu: I can run this. Do you want latency p50/p95, throughput, memory peak? Also which batch sizes?

jamie-runtime: p50 + p95 + peak memory please. Batch sizes: 1 and 8. Use the same perf CI image (sha: abc123) so results are comparable. No need for full rig — just single-run smoke.

alex-gpu: OK. I'll trigger on h100-1, a100-1, l40s-1. Command I'm going to use: 

```bash
./ci/bench/run_bench.sh --model rw-instruct-30b --seq 2048 --bs 1,8 --metrics p50,p95,mem --image abc123 --repeat 3
```

perf-bot: queued job 7890 on pool h100-1 (eta ~10m).

morgan-sre: fyi I peeked at the prod traces — there was a host-level checkpoint job coinciding with the tail spike on host-gpu-42. Could be noisy neighbor, but still worth validating raw HW numbers.

dena-eng: pinged infra to ensure no maintenance cron runs during the runs. @infra-team please hold background jobs on candidate hosts for 30m.

alex-gpu: runs finished, uploading summary. TL;DR below, full logs + flamegraphs in S3.

-- Batch size 1 (avg of 3 reps) --
H100: p50=410ms, p95=740ms, mem_peak=62GB, tokens/s~=41
A100: p50=530ms, p95=1010ms, mem_peak=70GB, tokens/s~=34
L40S: p50=470ms, p95=820ms, mem_peak=60GB, tokens/s~=38

-- Batch size 8 (avg of 3 reps) --
H100: p50=360ms, p95=980ms, mem_peak=64GB, tokens/s~=300
A100: p50=450ms, p95=1200ms, mem_peak=72GB, tokens/s~=260
L40S: p50=390ms, p95=1005ms, mem_peak=62GB, tokens/s~=285

Observations: H100 retains best p50 across both BS but p95 can spike (likely queuing under load). A100 shows consistently higher p95 and memory. L40S is close to H100 on tail for bs1 but slightly worse for bs8.

Logs + artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/1763001234/ (bench-summary.json, flamegraphs/, raw-traces/).

alex-gpu: quick note — one of the H100 reps had a host-level preemption event (see raw-traces/host-gpu-17) which inflated one p95 sample; excluding that run gives H100 p95 ~700ms.

jamie-runtime: perfect, thanks. Can you open a short issue with the numbers + link to artifacts and assign to me? I want to follow up with a targeted isolated run and also check model kv-cache alignment.

alex-gpu: done — https://tickets.redwood.ai/ISSUE-3421 (title: hw-smoke: h100/a100/l40s rw-instruct-30b 2048 smoke).

morgan-sre: for the triage, suggest 15m tomorrow to decide whether this is noisy neighbor vs runtime regression. I'll bring the host-level metrics.

jamie-runtime: sounds good, add calendar invite. Thanks all :thumbsup:

perf-bot: job 7890 completed successfully (logs uploaded).
